evidence_boundary: Complete immutable Ghidra program-memory body matches canonical function digest, 17 instruction boundaries, with no listing overrides. Stored original FileBytes are absent; no whole-XBE reauthentication. No original machine code or uploaded scripts executed.

logical_operation.input: Three live readable aligned binary32 float objects, loaded in original z/y/x order. No C++ FP conversion or host sqrt fallback.
logical_operation.sequence: Native x87 original stack sequence computes (x*x + y*y) + z*z then FSQRT. x87 intermediates are not silently narrowed or reassociated. Cleanup FSTP ST3, FSTP ST0, FSTP ST0 leaves one binary80 return result above the original live stack.
logical_operation.result: Native binary80 long double returned in ST0 on supported host ABI. Source signature float10 FUN_00314c76(float*) is unchanged.
logical_operation.peak_stack: Five additional entries at peak, one additional entry at return. The specific next five push destinations must all be empty; arbitrary free slots are insufficient.

original_register_contract.input: [entry ESP+4] is a guest pointer to three binary32 words. MOV EAX,[ESP+4], loads +8,+4,+0.
original_register_contract.output: Binary80 result in x87 ST0; EAX still contains the input guest address; RET4 consumes stack argument.
original_register_contract.not_implemented: Guest pointer translation, EAX/other GPR or integer EFLAGS transport, original x86 stack cleanup, fault/MMIO/concurrent observer behavior.

host_contract: GNU/Clang x86-64 Linux default SysV, native binary80 long double (64-bit mantissa, max exponent16384, min exponent-16381), IEEE binary32 float. Three live readable alignof(float)-aligned input objects; all x87 exceptions masked; next five physical push destinations empty. Fast math and unsupported architecture/type rejected.
return_boundary_justification: Capture bridge is authored out-of-line SysV assembly. It preserves RBX and caller FP state, aligns the CALL stack, restores the seed state, CALLs the full compiled candidate wrapper, then FXSAVEs immediately without a C++ long-double consumer. Only after capture does it restore caller FP state, including callee-saved CW/MXCSR controls, before its void return.

At Clang O0, helper may use FSTPT/FLDT and wrappers may add FLD ST0/FSTP ST0. GCC O0 also uses native binary80 spills. These are tested at the actual return boundary, including sparse input tags and all TOP values.

For finite binary32 inputs, nonzero squares/sums and results remain far inside binary80 exponent range: squares at least2^-298 and sum below2^258, hence nonzero result between2^-149 and2^129. No cancellation occurs. Original operations therefore yield zero, normal binary80, infinity or quiet NaN, never binary80 subnormal or signaling NaN.

Native80 copies do not narrow those values or add conversion exceptions. Extra duplicate/pop uses fewer slots than the original five-entry peak. Final original cleanup and return copies clear C1. Compared status equality is measured on tested native hardware; excluded instruction/data/opcode bookkeeping differs.
No universal CPU-context equivalence or original Pentium-III hardware execution is claimed.

compared_fxsave_fields.control_word: bytes 0..1, including exception masks, precision and rounding controls
compared_fxsave_fields.status_word: bytes 2..3, including sticky exception flags, condition bits and TOP
compared_fxsave_fields.abridged_tag_word: byte 4, mapping occupied physical x87 registers
compared_fxsave_fields.active_x87_stack_values: first 10 bytes of each 16-byte logical ST slot, only when its corresponding physical tag is nonempty using TOP
compared_fxsave_fields.mxcsr: bytes24..27; no SSE FP arithmetic in the operation, so every control and sticky flag must remain unchanged.

excluded_fxsave_fields.instruction_and_data_bookkeeping: FOP bytes 6..7, FIP bytes 8..15, FDP bytes 16..23 differ with native instruction/data addresses; not guest-address emulated
excluded_fxsave_fields.inactive_x87_payloads_and_slot_padding: Empty-tag register contents are not logical stack values; bytes 10..15 of ST storage slots are padding
excluded_fxsave_fields.xmm_register_values: Host compiler may use XMM registers for integer/memory movement; guest SIMD register preservation is part of the excluded ABI bridge
excluded_fxsave_fields.mxcsr_mask: bytes 28..31 describe hardware capabilities rather than operation results
excluded_fxsave_fields.reserved_fields: Not defined logical operation state; comparison does not assert complete FXSAVE image or CPU-context equivalence

limits: Bounded native host operation only; no full-game behavior, original Xbox execution, guest ABI bridge, native linkage or byte-identical rebuild claim.
No FIP/FDP/FOP comparison because compiled native return copies change instruction/data locations and last opcode.
No unmasked exception, invalid input memory, fault recovery, MMIO, concurrent memory observers or arbitrary byte-unaligned float-object contract.
Sanitizers cover C++ harness accesses; native assembly memory accesses additionally use guarded spans and sentinels. LeakSanitizer is disabled and untested.
Compiler/x87 implementations outside tested supported configurations are not established by these tests.
capture_boundary: Out-of-line SysV normal function, all x87/XMM registers caller-clobbered by ABI. FXRSTOR -> native CALL -> FXSAVE adjacent in authored assembly, with RBX and caller FP state preserved and normal 16-byte call alignment.

tests.extra: Independent finite order anchor x=3f800000,y=z=39800001 at PC24/nearest, distinguishing original result1+2^-23 from reversed result1; integer-encoded exact binary80 anchors, true live float objects with memcpy-in raw bits, 12-byte input ending at guard page, input sentinels, net return-stack effect and old active-stack preservation.
tests.oracle: Independently authored native original-sequence function; never extracted machine code execution.

gate_requirements: Mandatory historical source SHA/Git blob, exact reversal, original unresolved SQRT failure at O0/O2
Pinned helper/wrapper/oracle, narrow opcode mutations and optional full39-byte private body check
Full compiled source wrapper return-boundary tests at O0/O2; isolated codegen rejects external calls or FP narrowing
Negative reversed addition order, missing FSQRT, wrong cleanup target and binary32 return narrowing
Capture boundary structural negatives and unsupported architecture/binary80/fast-math compile negatives
